characters.name: Hare
characters.description: a fast, lean athletic hare with a glossy brown coat and an arrogant smirk

characters.name: Tortoise
characters.description: a slow, resolute tortoise with a rugged mossy shell and calm wise eyes

scenes.narration: One day, a hare was showing off how fast he could run. He laughed at the turtle for being so slow.

dialogue.speaker: Hare
dialogue.line: Look at me go! No one could ever be as fast as I am!

scenes.narration: The overconfident hare mocked the slow tortoise, who calmly challenged him to a race.

dialogue.speaker: Tortoise
dialogue.line: I race you, and I will win.

dialogue.speaker: Hare
dialogue.line: You? Race me? Fine! I accept!

scenes.narration: The race began and the hare shot ahead, racing far down the path in a blur.
Sure he had plenty of time, the hare stopped under a tree and fell fast asleep.
The tortoise kept walking slowly and steadily, never stopping along the whole path.
The hare woke to see the tortoise already crossing the finish line on the opposite side.

dialogue.speaker: Hare
dialogue.line: How did you get ahead of me?
